name: RC6 Steps 1-5
result: Principled architecture built: 143a ep30 = 66.89 (5/8). CLN + log-space + CRPS/VS/cell_var. Bitter Lesson confirmed.

name: RC7 Kurtosis Compass
result: Log-space dynamics solve kurtosis (exp(Gaussian)=log-normal). Student-t falsified. CLT is fundamental to additive AR.

name: RC8v3-H1: Learned scalar vol_scale
theory: Delta magnitude is 40-55% of GT because CRPS accuracy term discourages large outputs. A learned scalar scale decouples magnitude from direction. EMOS (Gneiting 2005) proves this is CRPS-optimal. Partially addresses mean reversion (bigger deltas → faster movement).
target: Delta magnitude increases to 80-100% of GT. h=7 coverage improves from 75% toward 85%+. Mean reversion gap at h=30 improves from 82% toward 77%.
falsification: Delta magnitude stays 40-55% of GT despite learned scale → CRPS suppresses scale parameter to near-zero.
implementation: Add self.log_vol_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(-3.9)) to CausalARTransformerDecoder. delta = softplus(self.log_vol_scale) * raw_delta. Init ≈ 0.02.

after_training: 1. Run test suite (v2) on BOTH best_model and final_model (per unstable training rule)
2. Re-run 7-diagnostic script: measure delta magnitude vs GT (target 80-100%)
3. Run mean reversion test: measure HIGH/LOW gap at h=30 (target ≤77%, was 82%)
4. Check learned scale value: print softplus(log_vol_scale) — did CRPS learn a reasonable value?
5. Compare spread pattern: re-measure per-cell spread ratio vs GT

name: RC8v3-H2: Per-cell learned scale
theory: Spread pattern is wrong — column 0 over-spread (2.0-2.2x GT), columns 2-3 under-spread (0.27-0.54x GT). Per-cell scale lets each cell find its own magnitude.
target: Per-cell spread ratio approaches 1.0 for all cells. Coverage uniformity improves.
falsification: Per-cell coverage doesn't improve → wrong pattern is from transformer internals, not output scaling.
verification_plan: Same 5-step plan as H1, plus check if per-cell scale values correlate with GT per-cell std.

name: RC8v3-H3: Increased capacity (d_model=128)
theory: If H1 fixes coverage but mean reversion is still too slow, the model needs more capacity to learn conditional dynamics (high IV → negative delta). 282K params may be insufficient.
target: Mean reversion gap at h=30 ≤ 77%. Daily change ACF closer to GT (-0.27).
falsification: Mean reversion unchanged at d_model=128 → it's not a capacity issue but a structural AR limitation.
verification_plan: Same 5-step plan plus mean reversion test on multiple cells.
